lines: Main chahta bhi yahi tha, woh bewafa nikle
couplets.en: I had wanted them to prove untrue.

lines: Use samajhne ka koi to silsila nikle
couplets.en: There might be some way to understand them.

lines: Kitaab ke panne ulat ke dekh zara
couplets.en: Turn the pages of the book and take a look.

lines: Na jaane kaun sa panna muda hua nikle
couplets.en: Who knows which page might have a corner turned down?

lines: Jo dekhne mein bahut hi qareeb lagta hai
couplets.en: Some people seem so very close.

lines: Usi ke baare mein socho to faasla nikle
couplets.en: Think of them a little longer and the distance comes into view.
